competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times to absorb its Attack Bar by 10% with a 25% chance each.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times to remove 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance each. When used on an enemy with no beneficial effects, the skill is activated after attacking the enemy first with [Backlash].

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
effets.note: When used on enemy with no beneficial effects, attacks with [Backlash] first.

competences.description: Leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 30% chance on each attack. When attacking an enemy granted with a beneficial effect on your turn, [Hunting Hawk] is activated in succession after the attack. [Automatic Effect]

Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
effets.note: When attacking an enemy granted with beneficial effect, [Hunting Hawk] is activated in succession after the attack.
